title: Wake & Vape Melon Cream 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Melon Cream from Wake & Vape E-Liquid is a truly mouth-watering fusion of fresh, light honeydew melon and the richest, silkiest cream. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks.
